Episodes.Title: Spring in a Heartbeat
Episodes.Actors: Yoo Byung-hoon, Lee Chun-moo, Choi Dae-hoon
Episodes.Plot: Raised by a tenacious mother, a young, bright-eyed Ae-sun has dreams bigger than her village - until an unexpected tragedy changes everything.

Episodes.Title: Sassy First Love
Episodes.Plot: As love blossoms between Ae-sun and Gwan-sik, they make their first bold move together. But their romantic adventure hits a snag.

Episodes.Title: Yesterday Was Your Spring
Episodes.Plot: After a dramatic rescue. Ae-sun and Gwan-sik return to Jeju. Soon, Ae-sun resigns herself to a sad fate - leaving Gwan-sik devastated.

Episodes.Title: The Blazing Summer Sunshine
Episodes.Actors: Park Bo-gum, Yoo Byung-hoon, Lee Chun-moo
Episodes.Plot: Summer brings joy as the newlyweds start a life together, but living with Gwan-sik's family tests their happiness - can they find a path to peace?

Episodes.Title: Episode #1.5
Episodes.Actors: Park Bo-gum, Yoo Byung-hoon, Lee Chun-moo
Episodes.Plot: As Gwan-sik struggles to find work, Ae-sun worries for her family -- until a lifeline appears. Soon after, Ae-sun sets her ambitions higher in Jeju.

Episodes.Title: Life Goes On and On
Episodes.Plot: Just as Ae-sun and Gwan-sik taste the joys of their new life, a summer storm changes everything - testing their will to carry on.

Episodes.Title: Episode #1.7
Episodes.Actors: Park Bo-gum, Yoo Byung-hoon, Lee Chun-moo
Episodes.Plot: As the village chief election approaches, Ae-sun faces corrupt opposition. Geum-myeong receives an unusual request that tests her morals.

Episodes.Title: Episode #1.8
Episodes.Actors: Yoo Byung-hoon, Lee Chun-moo, Choi Dae-hoon
Episodes.Plot: When Geum-myeong receives a chance to study in Japan, dreams take flight. Now Ae-sun and Gwan-sik must make a tough decision.

Episodes.Title: The Wind Goes Whoosh, My Heart Goes Boo-Hoo
Episodes.Plot: Life in a small apartment tests Ae-sun and Gwan-sik as they struggle to parent Yang Eun-myeong. Meanwhile, Geum-myeong juggles love and life in Seoul.

Episodes.Title: My Love by My Side
Episodes.Plot: As Geum-myeong's engagement moves toward marriage, her heart fills with doubt -- will her first love story find its happy ending like her mother's?

Episodes.Title: Such an Uneven Love
Episodes.Plot: While facing a career setback during an economic downturn, Geum-myeong encounters a familiar face -- sparking an unexpected new beginning.

Episodes.Title: Spread Your Wings and Fly
Episodes.Plot: Ae-sun and Gwan-sik grapple with Yang Eun-myeong's misfortune, sacrificing everything they can to help him. But Eun-myeong's self-confidence takes a hit.

Episodes.Title: A Spring Every Day
Episodes.Plot: Between new business ventures and career changes, the family faces separate hurdles on their paths -- drawing strength from their bond to press ahead.

Episodes.Title: Here's to All You've Been Through
Episodes.Plot: As the Yang family finally enjoys the fruits of their labor, sudden agony strikes -- testing their resolve and the strength of their enduring love.
